segments.name: insurance
segments.description: Writes coastal homeowners insurance, including single family, condominium and commercial residential policies, in Atlantic seaboard states.
segments.evidence: The Company has one reportable segment: insurance.

revenueModel.text: Policyholders pay premiums for homeowners insurance policies, which are earned pro rata over each policy's term.
revenueModel.evidence: The insurance segment derives revenues from direct and assumed premiums written which revenues are earned pro rata over the terms of the policies, or remaining term of the policy for policies assumed post their origination date.

changes.text: In December 2023, the Company sold the commercial book of business of Clegg, a renewal-rights acquisition.
changes.evidence: In December of 2023, the Company sold the commercial book of business of Clegg, which resulted in a decrease to the intangible asset of $ 435 .
